limits: Elapsed wall-clock Step measurements, not per-step CPU milliseconds or thread-cycle conversion.
Same-model baseline/candidate snapshot/work parity passes. Different Native/Momentum worlds perform differing AI/visibility/combat work; full delta is not solver-only.
Observed same-model p95 decreases do not establish a randomized CPU causal effect. Proving Ground relative5% proxy still FAILS; Sanctorus passes this proxy only.
Verification hashes cover actual published snapshot payloads, not all nonserialized game state. Timing runs disable hashing and diagnostic solver capture.
